library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;
use ieee.numeric_std.all;
entity top is
  port (
    x: in unsigned (7 downto 0);
    n: out natural range 0 to 8
  );
end entity;

library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;
use ieee.numeric_std.all;

architecture rtl of top is

  signal n97 : std_logic_vector (3 downto 0);

begin
  wrap_x <= typ_wrap_x(x);
  n <= to_integer (unsigned (wrap_n));
  wrap_n <= n97;
  -- top.vhd:20:11
  n4 <= wrap_x (0);
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n11 <= "1000" when n4 = '0' else "0000";
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n15 <= '1' when n4 = '0' else '0';
  -- top.vhd:20:11
  n17 <= wrap_x (1);
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n19 <= n11 when n28 = '0' else "0001";
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n23 <= n15 when n29 = '0' else '0';
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n25 <= n15 and n17;
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n26 <= n15 and n17;
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n28 <= n25 and n15;
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n29 <= n26 and n15;
  -- top.vhd:20:11
  n30 <= wrap_x (2);
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n32 <= n19 when n41 = '0' else "0010";
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n36 <= n23 when n42 = '0' else '0';
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n38 <= n23 and n30;
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n39 <= n23 and n30;
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n41 <= n38 and n23;
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n42 <= n39 and n23;

  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n49 <= n36 when n55 = '0' else '0';

  n51 <= n36 and n43;
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n52 <= n36 and n43;
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n54 <= n51 and n36;
  -- top.vhd:20:7
  n55 <= n52 and n36;

  n56 <= wrap_x (4);
  -- top.vhd:20:7
